recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future publisher or stylesheet change makes the generated diff page overflow again; there is no current FHIR-core source correction required for FHIR-13153.
issue_request: FHIR-13153 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for the FHIR-core diff page, raised in DSTU2 and applied for STU3. It reported that the diff table required multiple horizontal scrolls and requested that long lines wrap so the table fits the normal page layout.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 11888, represented in git as f844e2dbd6a40f5ee02e11c5dcd3aecb81090d0a with subject '#13153 - fix diff table (and produce computable forms)'. That commit widened source/diff.html from col-9 to col-12, changed generated diff entries from raw cell text into list items, split binding code changes into add/remove list lines, and added XML/JSON computable diff outputs.
additional_context: The current hierarchy includes diff.html, diff-r4.html, diff-r4b.html, and diff-r5.html under the Documentation section, so the inspected diff pages are in build scope. Current source/diff*.html pages contain diff-analysis directives and links to computable XML/JSON diff outputs, while current CI-rendered diff.html shows a col-12 wrapper and generated diff rows using diff-title/diff-item table rows with ul/li content. Jira search found only FHIR-13153 for the exact diff.html wide-table concern; Zulip only showed the tracker bot notification; Confluence had no direct references or exact phrase hits.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the approved layout fix was already applied historically and no active current source defect was found.
